steps.decide: Whether the control is an action or a navigation, and therefore a button or a link
The variant set, limited to distinct intents the page actually needs
Loading, success and error behaviour, including the label in each
Motion for every transition and its reduced-motion equivalent

rules.statement: An action is a button and a destination is a link; role is decided before styling and never inferred from appearance.
Each variant maps to one intent; two variants that differ only in hue are one variant with a mistake.
During loading the label states what is happening in the same grammatical form as the action (Saving...), and the control keeps its width.
A pressed button disables until the first request settles, the guard lives in the handler rather than the spinner, and the request carries an idempotency key reused on retry.
Every state transition carries an explicit motion decision, and motion none states why.

motion.noneReason: the press is already over; animating the start delays the only feedback that matters
motion.reducedMotion: label swaps instantly; no spinner that hides the label

motion.noneReason: error feedback must not wait for a fade
motion.reducedMotion: label and error text appear instantly

motion.noneReason: a retry is a deliberate act and needs no transition

transitions.trigger: success acknowledged or the view moves on

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: a response for a superseded request is discarded; the control reflects the latest request only

refused.reason: a ghost button is for non-committal actions; async work uses a primary control
nothing to confirm without an async action
errors attach to the async control that owns the request
a destructive action confirms by consequence, not by a success tick on the button

sections.intent: Let the user commit to one action with immediate, unambiguous feedback about what happened.
nicheDifferences: Operate consoles tolerate compact buttons; marketing pages need a larger single action
Commerce buttons must state the amount when it is the commitment
inputs: Whether it writes to a server
anatomy: Button element with a stable label width
styling: Variant maps to intent, not to colour preference
Disabled state is visibly distinct and explained
Focus ring never overlaps the label
a11y: Real button element for actions, link for navigation
Loading state announced through the label change
Error text associated with the control
Keyboard and touch both produce the same result
responsive: Label wraps rather than truncates at 320px
Full-width only where the layout calls for it
copy: Label is a verb in the user's terms
Loading label keeps the same verb form
Error names the failure and the retry
alternatives: A link styled as a button is legitimate for navigation
A spinner-only state is not an alternative; it hides the label

references.label: HTML Living Standard: interactive content and labelling

failureCases: Success shown for an unconfirmed request
